overloadMerges.note: Two doc syntax lines differ only in whether a leading '*' is passed (selecting whether 'object' is an object-name string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator instead of two overloads sharing one semanticRole.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'object' below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, 'object' is a Variable/Field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if '*' passed) or Variable/field reference (if '*' omitted)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Re-evaluates and re-displays the current value of any dynamic 4D expressions found in the designated multi-style/4D Write Pro object, without altering the styled text itself.
